data.title: 战栗的龙卷 · 浮空花廊的傲娇花嫁
data.description: 【A 市高层花廊·黄昏】龙卷用念动力托住裙摆，穿着黑绿相间的婚纱悬浮在玫瑰花廊中央；她一手抱花、一手叉腰，先嫌弃头纱太长，听见钟声后却把脸别开，耳尖泛起不肯承认的红。
data.location: high-rise rose promenade above City A
data.action: 玫瑰花廊上用念动力托起头纱悬浮，听见钟声后别脸耳尖发红
data.lighting: sunset rim light with emerald telekinetic fill
data.mood: 最强超能力者不肯承认的柔软
data.promptProse: Tatsumaki holds the bouquet in one arm, other hand on her hip, turning her blushing face aside; telekinesis lifts the veil and hem clear of the floor, golden-hour light rimming the veil against emerald light.
data.animaCaption: One arm holds the bouquet while telekinesis lifts the veil and hem clear of the floor.
